status: PROPOSED — provider implemented and tested locally; no consumer wired; not integrator-reviewed

auth.token: scm.delegation.v1 (HMAC-SHA256 over base64url JSON claims; see src/infrastructure/delegation.js)
auth.issuer: core Identity owner (gate SCM-CORE); tests use a synthetic issuer
auth.scopeDenial: 404 SCM_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND — identical for unknown and forbidden (FR-072 non-enumeration)

mutations.idempotency: Idempotency-Key header required (8-200 of [A-Za-z0-9._:-]); scoped by tenant+business+action+actor; same key+same payload → 200 replayed:true with the stored outcome; same key+different payload/target → 409 SCM_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT; replay re-checks current authority; commerce.pricing.calculate binds the key per Business (any owner) to the NORMALIZED request and answers a reuse with 409 PRICING_CALCULATION_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, and its replay/lookup re-checks that the policy is still the usable latest one (409 PRICING_RULE_NOT_ACTIVE)
mutations.unknownOutcome: on network loss or 5xx, GET /v1/operations/{action}/{key}?businessId= — never resend with a new key

routes.capability: procurement.receipt.post | owner; counted lines additionally inventory domain + (inventory.catalog.write | owner)
commerce domain + (commerce.order.write | owner) + (inventory.catalog.write | owner); counted lines also inventory domain
routes.references: branch (core), customer (CRM), slip fileAsset (Files) via ReferenceAuthority; owner unavailable → 503 SCM_REFERENCE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE
routes.invariant: payment is always PENDING; price is manual

routes.references: customer + conversation (CRM) via ReferenceAuthority; a Business-bound reference must be VISIBLE to the actor (legacy seesBusiness)
routes.invariant: DRAFT; conversation makes origin CHAT and supplies its customer; mismatch → 422

routes.note: open orders by default + summary {open, unpaid, pendingPayments}

routes.capability: commerce.order.write | owner; COMPLETE+issueStock also (inventory.catalog.write | owner) and inventory domain
routes.invariant: lines editable only in DRAFT; whole-order shortage refused before any issue; serial lines refused; CAS on version

routes.note: customer is an id reference (+code when known); display fields stay with CRM

routes.references: slip fileAsset (Files) via ReferenceAuthority when slipFileAssetId is given
routes.invariant: recorded PENDING; bank reference unique per Tenant; no PAYMENT on a CANCELLED order (REFUND allowed)
FR-196: recorder cannot verify own payment (owner included) without selfVerifyAttested; REFUND verify ≤ verified net; CAS on version

routes.note: VERIFIED net of VERIFIED refunds by origin and Asia/Bangkok day of payment; pending PAYMENTs beside it; rejected never counted; from/to are YYYY-MM-DD Bangkok days; parity-pinned by contracts/v1/revenue-parity-*.json

routes.capability: commerce domain + Business OWNER (no permission grants it)

routes.capability: commerce domain + Business OWNER (no permission grants it)
